context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 釜/両替/酸性/バニラ/ともだち/オールスター/ジャイアンツ/ペラペラ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お正月の、絶対、お釜、絶対、お祖母ちゃんから、絶対、もらったわよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — Granny gave you that beautiful iron pot for New Year's, didn't she.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate certainty. Slight upward lift on the name. Voice settles into a gentle confirmation, like she's reminding him of something lovely he already knows.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、両替、絶対、機、絶対、初めて、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mom, seriously — I saw a money-exchange machine for the first time today!
lines.style: Bright, genuine wonder. Quick opening energy on the name. Each phrase tumbles out with the excitement of a small discovery. Eyes wide in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お酢は、本気で、絶対、酸性、絶対、なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Vinegar is acidic, you know, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful delivery. Slight pause before the explanation. A mother sharing a small fact the way she'd point out something interesting on a walk. Quiet, grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、バニラ、絶対、アイス、絶対、食べたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to eat vanilla ice cream!
lines.style: Eager, hopeful pitch. The want is sincere but still small-voiced. A rise at the end like a question, testing if maybe, just maybe, this is the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、ともだち、絶対、優しい子たち、絶対、ばかりよね
lines.en: Sho's friends are all such kind kids, aren't they.
lines.style: Tender observation, almost to herself. Soft, warm certainty. The tone of someone noticing something true and good about her son's world. A private moment of quiet pride.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、野球の、絶対、オールスター、絶対、戦、絶対、見るんだって
lines.en: Dad said he's going to watch the All-Star baseball game.
lines.style: Bright reporting. Direct, factual, but with the shine of sharing something Dad is excited about. No judgment — just passing along the news he cares about.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんは、本気で、絶対、ジャイアンツ、絶対、ファン、絶対、なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your father is a Giants fan, Sho.
lines.style: Settled, gentle explanation. A soft chuckle underneath, like she's long accepted this about him. Warm acknowledgment of his father's personality delivered without criticism.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、英語、絶対、ペラペラ、絶対、なんだよね
lines.en: Grandpa speaks English really fluently, doesn't he.
lines.style: Admiring, slightly amazed. Soft respect in the voice. She's noticing something impressive about someone she loves and sharing that appreciation with Sho. Genuine delight.
